recipes.title: Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced chicken, caramelized onions, mint, and saffron.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then soak for 20 minutes.
steps.tip: Soaking keeps the grains long and separate.

steps.text: Mix the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, biryani masala, half the mint and cilantro, lemon juice, and salt. Let it marinate while the rice soaks.
Add the onions and cook until golden brown.
steps.tip: Stir often and keep the heat at medium so the onions caramelize without burning.

steps.text: Add the tomatoes and the marinated chicken. Cook until the chicken is sealed and the oil starts to separate.
Boil the soaked rice in salted water until 70% cooked, then drain.
steps.tip: The grains should still have a firm center.

steps.text: Layer the rice over the chicken. Top with the remaining mint and cilantro, the saffron milk, and the ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat so the steam finishes the rice.
steps.tip: Seal the lid with foil or a damp cloth to trap the steam.

steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes, then fluff gently from the edges and serve with raita.

recipes.title: Chicken Karahi
recipes.description: A bold, tomato-forward Pakistani classic with ginger, green chilies, and a glossy finish.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok or karahi over high heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chicken and fry on high heat until the pieces turn pale golden on all sides.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell is gone.
Add the tomatoes, salt, chili powder, and coriander. Cover and cook on medium heat until the tomatoes break down completely.
steps.tip: Press the tomatoes against the side of the pan to speed things up.

steps.text: Uncover and cook on high heat, stirring, until the oil rises to the surface and the masala clings to the chicken.
Add the green chilies, ginger, and black pepper. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Finish with fresh cilantro and serve straight from the pan with hot naan.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
recipes.description: Silky spaghetti in a quick garlic-parmesan cream sauce, ready in under half an hour.

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
steps.tip: Pasta water is the secret to a glossy sauce.

steps.text: Melt the butter with the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, without browning.
steps.tip: Browned garlic turns bitter, so lower the heat if it colors fast.

steps.text: Pour in the cream, add the pepper and chili flakes, and simmer gently until slightly thickened.
Stir in the parmesan until the sauce is smooth.
Add the spaghetti and toss, loosening with splashes of pasta water until the sauce coats every strand.
Finish with parsley and extra parmesan. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Tender chicken and penne in a garlicky cream sauce with mushrooms and parmesan.

steps.text: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano. Sear in olive oil until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and mushrooms until soft and lightly browned.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in the stock and cream. Simmer until the sauce coats a spoon.
Return the chicken to the pan, stir in the parmesan, and add the penne.
Toss until everything is glossy and hot. Taste and adjust the salt before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: A moist, deeply chocolatey layer cake with silky ganache and fresh berries.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F). Grease and line two 20 cm (8 in) round pans.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and a pinch of salt in a large bowl.
Add the eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla. Beat until smooth, then stir in the hot coffee. The batter will be thin.
steps.tip: A thin batter is what makes the cake moist.

steps.text: Divide between the pans and bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack and cool completely.
For the ganache, pour the hot cream over the chopped chocolate. Wait 2 minutes, then stir until glossy. Let it thicken.
Spread ganache between the layers and over the top and sides. Finish with berries.

recipes.title: Beef Burger
recipes.description: Juicy smashed-style beef patties with melted cheese, crisp lettuce, and a toasted bun.

steps.text: Divide the beef into 4 loose balls without overworking it. Season generously with salt and pepper just before cooking.
steps.tip: Handling the meat as little as possible keeps the patties tender.

steps.text: Heat a heavy pan or griddle until very hot. Press each ball flat into a patty and cook until a dark crust forms.
Flip, top with cheddar, and cook until the cheese melts.
Toast the buttered buns cut-side down until golden.
Spread mayonnaise and ketchup on the buns. Stack lettuce, patty, tomato, and onion, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Thick, tender buttermilk pancakes with golden edges. Serve with berries and maple syrup.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl.
In another bowl, mix the buttermilk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir just until combined. A few lumps are fine.
steps.tip: Overmixing makes pancakes tough. Rest the batter for 5 minutes.

steps.text: Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Pour in about a quarter cup of batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, then flip and cook until golden.
Stack and serve warm with berries, butter, and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: Smoky, herb-marinated chicken breasts served with a crisp salad and roasted vegetables.

steps.text: Mix the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, paprika, salt, and pepper. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Pound the thickest part of each breast lightly so they cook evenly.
Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high. Grill the chicken until it has char marks and reaches 74°C (165°F) inside.
steps.tip: Turn only once so you get clean grill marks.

steps.text: Grill the zucchini and tomatoes alongside until softened and lightly charred.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice and serve over the salad leaves with the vegetables.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Bright, zesty chicken thighs with lemon, garlic, and thyme, grilled until crisp at the edges.

steps.text: Zest one lemon and squeeze both. Mix the zest and juice with the oil, garlic, thyme, honey, salt, and pepper.
Coat the chicken thighs and let them sit while you heat the grill.
Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, and toss them in a little of the marinade.
Grill the chicken skin-side down until the skin is crisp, then flip and cook through. Grill the potatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Chicken thighs are done at 80°C (175°F) and stay juicy.

steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes and serve with the potatoes and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Mango Smoothie
recipes.description: A creamy, sunny mango smoothie with yogurt and a hint of cardamom.

steps.text: Add the mango, yogurt, milk, honey, and cardamom to a blender.
Blend on high until completely smooth.
steps.tip: Frozen mango makes it thicker and colder, so skip the ice if you use it.

steps.text: Add the ice and blend again for a few seconds.
Taste and add more honey if needed. Pour into glasses and serve right away.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Crisp-edged, buttery garlic bread with parsley and a golden cheesy top.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley, and salt until evenly combined.
Slice the loaf in half lengthwise and spread the garlic butter generously over both cut sides.
Scatter the mozzarella on top. Bake until the cheese is bubbling and the edges are golden.
steps.tip: For extra crunch, finish under the broiler for 1 minute.

steps.text: Cut into pieces and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chicken & Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: A comforting, clear chicken soup packed with carrots, celery, potatoes, and fresh herbs.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Stir in the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the stock, bay leaf, and chicken.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
steps.tip: Skim any foam from the surface for a clearer soup.

steps.text: Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the potatoes to the pot and simmer until tender.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, stir in the parsley, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Pulao
recipes.description: A gentle, aromatic one-pot rice and chicken dish, the kind that tastes like home.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the oil and fry the onions until deep golden. Remove half for garnish.
Add the whole spices and cumin, then the chicken and ginger-garlic paste. Fry until the chicken changes color.
Pour in 4 cups of water, add the salt, and simmer until the chicken is nearly tender.
Add the rice, bring to a boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat until the water is absorbed.
steps.tip: Do not lift the lid while the rice steams.

steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes, fluff gently, and top with the reserved fried onions.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.description: A moist, golden loaf made with very ripe bananas, perfect with butter and coffee.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a loaf pan with parchment.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl until mostly smooth.
Stir in the melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon until just combined, then the walnuts.
steps.tip: Stop mixing as soon as no dry flour remains.

steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake until a skewer comes out clean. Cover with foil if the top browns too fast.
Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then lift out and cool on a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Spicy Green Chutney
recipes.description: A fiery, fresh mint and cilantro chutney for samosas, kebabs, and sandwiches.

steps.text: Wash the cilantro and mint well and pat them dry.
Add everything to a blender with 3 tablespoons of cold water.
Blend until smooth, adding a spoon of water at a time if needed.
steps.tip: Cold water keeps the chutney bright green.

steps.text: Taste and adjust the salt, lemon, and chili. Chill before serving.

recipes.title: Tomato Chicken Rice
recipes.description: A cozy one-pot dinner of juicy chicken simmered with rice in a rich tomato base.

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt, paprika, and cumin. Brown in the oil in a wide pot, then set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper in the same pot until soft, then add the garlic.
Stir in the rice and the crushed tomatoes and cook for a minute.
Add the stock, nestle the chicken on top, and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
steps.tip: Resist stirring so the rice steams evenly.

steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes, fluff, and serve.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken Pilaf
recipes.description: Fluffy rice cooked with chicken, carrots, and warm spices, with only one pot to wash.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in a heavy pot, then remove it to a plate.
Add the onion and cook until golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, and turmeric.
Add the carrots and the rinsed rice and stir for a minute to coat the grains.
Pour in the stock, add the salt, and return the chicken to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat until the liquid is absorbed.
steps.tip: Wrap the lid in a clean towel to keep steam from escaping.

steps.text: Rest for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
recipes.description: A fluffy omelette with onion, tomato, green chili and fresh coriander.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper until no streaks of white remain.
Stir in the onion, tomato, chili and coriander.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
steps.tip: The pan is ready when a drop of egg sizzles gently.

steps.text: Pour in the eggs and let them set for 2 minutes, lifting the edges so raw egg runs underneath.
Flip once, cook another minute and serve hot with toast or paratha.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Creamy oats soaked in milk and yogurt, ready to eat straight from the fridge.

steps.text: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, honey and chia seeds together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
steps.tip: Thinner oats? Add a splash more milk before serving.

steps.text: Top with banana and nuts just before eating.
Eat cold, or warm it for 1 minute in the microwave.

recipes.title: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Flaky flatbread stuffed with spiced mashed potato, best with yogurt and pickle.

steps.text: Knead the flour, water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough. Rest it for 20 minutes.
Mix the mashed potato with cumin, chili flakes, coriander and salt.
Divide the dough into 8 balls. Flatten one, add a spoon of filling, pinch it closed and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot griddle, brushing with ghee, until golden spots appear on both sides.
steps.tip: Press the edges lightly so the paratha puffs.

steps.text: Serve hot with yogurt and pickle.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: A crunchy salad of chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and herbs with a lemon dressing.

steps.text: Rinse the chickpeas well and let them drain.
Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and parsley in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and salt, then pour over the salad.
Toss and rest for 10 minutes so the flavors blend.

recipes.title: Daal Chawal
recipes.description: Comforting yellow lentils with a sizzling garlic and cumin tarka, served over rice.

steps.text: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear.
Simmer the lentils with water, turmeric and salt until completely soft.
steps.tip: Skim off any foam that rises.

steps.text: Mash lightly with a spoon so the daal is thick and creamy.
Heat the oil and fry the cumin, garlic and chilies until the garlic turns golden.
Pour the sizzling tarka over the daal and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
recipes.description: Soft paneer cubes in a smooth, gently spiced spinach sauce.

steps.text: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then cool in cold water and blend to a smooth purée.
Fry the cumin, onion, garlic and ginger in oil until the onion softens.
Add the tomato and cook until it breaks down, then pour in the spinach purée and salt.
Add the paneer and garam masala and simmer gently.
steps.tip: Do not boil hard or the paneer turns rubbery.

steps.text: Stir in the cream and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.description: Wok-fried rice with chicken, egg and crisp vegetables, ready in 25 minutes.

steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until cooked through, then set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan and break them into small pieces.
Add the garlic and vegetables and fry on high heat for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and soy sauce and toss until every grain is coated and hot.
steps.tip: Day-old rice fries best because it is drier.

steps.text: Return the chicken, add the spring onions and sesame oil, and serve at once.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crisp-tender vegetables tossed in a garlicky ginger and soy sauce.

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce and honey in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a wok over the highest heat.
steps.tip: A very hot pan keeps the vegetables crisp.

steps.text: Stir-fry the carrot and broccoli for 3 minutes.
Add the pepper, mushrooms, garlic and ginger and fry for 2 more minutes.
Pour in the sauce, toss for 30 seconds and serve over rice or noodles.

recipes.title: Seekh Kebab
recipes.description: Juicy spiced beef mince grilled on skewers, with mint chutney on the side.

steps.text: Knead the mince with every other ingredient for 5 minutes until sticky and well combined.
steps.tip: Squeezing the onion dry stops the kebabs falling apart.

steps.text: Rest the mixture in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Wet your hands and press the mixture around skewers into long, even shapes.
Grill or pan-cook over medium-high heat, turning often, until browned and cooked through.
steps.tip: The center must be hot and no longer pink.

steps.text: Serve with chutney, onion rings and naan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Spaghetti with golden garlic, olive oil and chili: simple, fast and full of flavor.

steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente. Save a cup of the pasta water.
Warm the oil and garlic over low heat until the garlic is just golden.
steps.tip: Garlic that browns turns bitter, so keep the heat low.

steps.text: Add the chili flakes, then the drained pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Toss over the heat until the sauce clings to the pasta.
Finish with parsley and parmesan and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Toasted bread piled with lemony mashed avocado and a pinch of chili.

steps.text: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and salt, leaving some chunks.
Spread it thickly on the toast.
Finish with chili flakes and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Kheer
recipes.description: Slow-simmered creamy rice pudding scented with cardamom and topped with nuts.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20 minutes, then drain.
Bring the milk to a boil, add the rice and cardamom, and lower the heat.
Simmer, stirring often, until the rice is very soft and the milk has thickened.
steps.tip: Scrape the bottom often so it does not catch.

steps.text: Stir in the sugar and raisins and cook for 5 more minutes.
Serve warm or chilled, topped with almonds and pistachios.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: Airy, rich chocolate mousse made with just four ingredients.

steps.text: Melt the chocolate gently over a pan of simmering water, then let it cool slightly.
Stir the egg yolks into the chocolate one at a time.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold half into the chocolate.
Whisk the egg whites with the salt and sugar to stiff peaks.
steps.tip: Make sure the bowl is completely free of grease.

steps.text: Fold in the whites gently, divide into glasses and chill for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Classic Hummus
recipes.description: Silky chickpea dip with tahini, lemon and garlic, perfect with warm bread.

steps.text: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until pale and thick.
Add the garlic, 2 tablespoons of oil and salt and blend again.
Add the chickpeas and blend until very smooth, adding cold water to loosen it.
steps.tip: A few extra minutes of blending makes it silkier.

steps.text: Spoon into a bowl, swirl the top and finish with oil and paprika.

recipes.title: Lemon Mint Cooler
recipes.description: A bright, icy lemonade with crushed mint, ideal for hot afternoons.

steps.text: Crush the mint with the sugar in a jug until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice and salt and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Pour in the cold water and mix well.
Serve over plenty of ice with extra mint.

recipes.title: Chana Chaat
recipes.description: Tangy chickpea chaat with onion, tomato, cucumber and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.text: Toss the chickpeas, onion, tomato and cucumber in a large bowl.
Add the chaat masala, lemon juice, chili and coriander.
Mix well and taste, adding more lemon or masala if you like.
steps.tip: Serve right away so the vegetables stay crisp.

steps.text: Serve cold in small bowls.

recipes.title: Anda Curry
recipes.description: Hard-boiled eggs simmered in a spiced onion and tomato gravy.

steps.text: Fry the onions in oil until deep golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute until fragrant.
Stir in the turmeric, chili, coriander and salt, then pour in the tomato purée.
Cook until the oil separates from the gravy.
steps.tip: Add a splash of water if it starts to stick.

steps.text: Score the eggs lightly, add them with a cup of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and serve with roti or rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with peas, carrots and whole spices.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20 minutes, then drain.
Fry the whole spices and cumin in ghee until they sizzle.
Add the onion and cook until golden, then add the vegetables.
Add the rice, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly, lower the heat and cook until the water is absorbed.
steps.tip: Do not lift the lid while it cooks.

steps.text: Rest for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
recipes.description: Marinated chicken strips in a warm wrap with crunchy vegetables and garlic sauce.

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, garlic, lemon, spices and salt. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
steps.tip: Overnight in the fridge tastes even better.

steps.text: Cook the chicken in a very hot pan in batches until browned and cooked through.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Spread garlic sauce on each bread, add chicken and vegetables, and roll tightly.
Cut in half and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi
recipes.description: A thick, cooling yogurt drink with ripe mango and a pinch of cardamom.

steps.text: Add the mango, yogurt, milk, sugar, cardamom and ice to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth and frothy.
steps.tip: Frozen mango makes it thicker and colder.

steps.text: Taste and add more sugar if the mango is not sweet.
Pour into tall glasses and serve at once.

recipes.title: Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Smooth roasted-tomato soup with garlic and basil, wonderful with toast.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 C (400 F). Spread the tomatoes, onion and garlic on a tray, drizzle with oil and season.
Roast until the tomatoes are soft and lightly charred.
Tip everything into a pot with the stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the basil and blend until smooth.
steps.tip: Blend hot soup in small batches and vent the lid.

steps.text: Stir in the sugar, adjust the seasoning and serve hot.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.description: Golden, custardy slices of bread with cinnamon, ready in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each bread slice for a few seconds per side so it soaks without falling apart.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the slices until golden on both sides.
steps.tip: Medium heat keeps the center cooked and the outside from burning.

steps.text: Serve with honey, fruit or maple syrup.

recipes.title: Fruit Chaat
recipes.description: A bright bowl of seasonal fruit with chaat masala, lemon and a hint of sweetness.

steps.text: Combine all the fruit in a large bowl.
Sprinkle over the chaat masala, lemon juice and sugar.
Toss gently and chill for 15 minutes.
steps.tip: Add the banana last so it does not turn soft.

steps.text: Serve cold.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Yogurt and spice marinated chicken pieces, grilled until smoky and juicy.

steps.text: Mix the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, tikka masala, chili powder, salt and oil into a smooth marinade.
Coat the chicken in the marinade, cover and refrigerate.
steps.tip: Overnight gives the best flavour; 2 hours is the minimum.

steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between the pieces.
Grill or roast at high heat, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
steps.tip: Brush with a little oil halfway so the surface stays juicy.

steps.text: Rest for a few minutes and serve with mint chutney, onion rings and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Handi
recipes.description: Creamy, mildly spiced chicken curry cooked slowly in a heavy pot.

steps.text: Fry the onions in oil until light golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and the chicken, and cook until the chicken changes colour.
Stir in the tomatoes, coriander powder, chili and salt. Cover and cook on low heat.
steps.tip: Add a splash of water only if the pot looks dry.

steps.text: Whisk the yogurt until smooth, add it and cook uncovered until the oil separates.
Stir in the cream and garam masala, simmer for a few minutes and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Chapli Kebab
recipes.description: Flat, crisp-edged beef kebabs with pomegranate seeds, tomato and coriander.

steps.text: Mix the beef with the onion, tomato, chilies, coriander, crushed seeds, pomegranate seeds, gram flour, egg and salt.
Knead well so the mixture turns sticky, then chill.
steps.tip: Chilling makes the patties easier to shape and keeps them together.

steps.text: Shape into flat patties about 1 cm thick and 10 cm wide.
Shallow-fry in hot oil until the underside is deep brown and crisp.
Flip and fry the other side. Serve hot with naan, chutney and sliced onion.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
recipes.description: Potato and cauliflower cooked dry with turmeric, cumin and fresh coriander.

steps.text: Heat the oil and add the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the onion and cook until soft, then stir in the tomato and the spices.
Add the potatoes and cauliflower with the salt and mix to coat in the masala.
Cover and cook on low heat, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are tender.
steps.tip: No water needed: the vegetables steam in their own moisture.

steps.text: Finish with fresh coriander and serve with roti.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy tomato and onion masala.

steps.text: Heat the oil, add the cumin seeds and the onions, and cook until deep golden.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste, then the tomato puree and the spices. Cook until the oil separates.
Add the chickpeas and half a cup of water. Simmer, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce.
Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice, and adjust the salt.
Serve with rice, naan or puri.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Quick wok-fried rice with scrambled egg, spring onion and soy sauce.

steps.text: Heat half the oil in a wok over high heat. Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil and the garlic, and stir for a few seconds.
Add the cold rice and toss, pressing out any lumps, until it is hot and starting to crisp.
steps.tip: Day-old rice fries better than freshly cooked rice.

steps.text: Return the egg, add the soy sauce, pepper and most of the spring onion, and toss to combine.
Finish with the sesame oil and the remaining spring onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
recipes.description: Stir-fried noodles with chicken, cabbage and carrot in a savoury sauce.

steps.text: Cook the noodles as the packet says, drain and toss with a little oil so they do not stick.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until cooked through, then remove from the pan.
In the same pan, stir-fry the garlic, carrot and cabbage on high heat until just tender.
steps.tip: Keep the heat high so the vegetables stay crisp.

steps.text: Add the noodles, chicken, soy sauce, oyster sauce and pepper, and toss until everything is coated.
Scatter the spring onions over the top and serve at once.

recipes.title: Vegetable Samosa
recipes.description: Crisp pastry parcels filled with spiced potato and peas.

steps.text: Rub the flour, 4 tbsp oil and half a teaspoon of salt together, add water and knead a firm dough. Rest it under a damp cloth.
For the filling, fry the cumin seeds in a little oil, then mix in the potatoes, peas, spices and remaining salt.
Divide the dough into 6 balls and roll each into a thin oval. Cut each oval in half.
Shape each half into a cone, fill it, and seal the edges with a little water.
steps.tip: Press the seam firmly or the samosa will open in the oil.

steps.text: Fry in moderately hot oil until golden and crisp on all sides. Drain and serve with chutney.
steps.tip: Oil that is too hot browns the pastry before the inside is cooked.

recipes.title: Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Thin homemade pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella and fresh basil.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and salt. Add the water and oil and knead until smooth.
Cover and let the dough rise until doubled.
steps.tip: A warm spot speeds this up.

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a tray or stone inside.
Stretch the dough thin on a floured sheet, spread with passata and sprinkle with oregano, then add the mozzarella.
Bake on the hot tray until the crust is blistered and the cheese bubbles. Top with basil.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: A slow-simmered beef and tomato sauce over spaghetti.

steps.text: Soften the onion and carrot in olive oil, then add the garlic for a minute.
Add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, pepper and a splash of water. Simmer gently.
steps.tip: The longer it simmers, the deeper the flavour.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with fresh tomato and basil.

steps.text: Toss the tomatoes with half the oil, the vinegar, basil and salt. Leave to sit.
steps.tip: Resting draws out the juices and sweetens the tomatoes.

steps.text: Brush the bread slices with the remaining oil.
Toast the slices under a hot grill or in a pan until golden on both sides.
Rub each warm slice lightly with a cut garlic clove.
Spoon the tomatoes on top and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Cucumber, tomato, olives and feta in a lemon and oregano dressing.

steps.text: Place the cucumber, tomatoes, onion and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt into a dressing.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss gently.
Top with the feta in a thick slice or crumbled, and serve at once.
steps.tip: Add the feta last so it keeps its shape.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine, grilled chicken, croutons and a creamy garlic dressing.

steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in a hot pan with a little oil until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Toss the bread cubes with oil and toast in the oven or a pan until golden and crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic and a splash of water into a pourable dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, top with the chicken, croutons and Parmesan.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: Golden, buttery bread with a melting cheese centre.

steps.text: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place one slice, butter side down, in a cold pan. Top with the cheese and the second slice, butter side up.
Cook over medium-low heat until the underside is deep golden.
steps.tip: Low and slow melts the cheese before the bread burns.

steps.text: Flip and cook the other side until golden and the cheese is melted.
Rest for a minute, then cut diagonally and serve.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

steps.text: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil until tender.
Add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes and salt. Simmer until thick.
steps.tip: The sauce should be thick enough that the eggs do not sink.

steps.text: Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook gently until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft.
Scatter with herbs and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Creamy scrambled eggs cooked low and slow.

steps.text: Beat the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, pulling the curds across the pan.
steps.tip: Take the pan off the heat while they still look slightly wet: they finish cooking on the plate.

steps.text: Serve straight away on toast, topped with chives.

recipes.title: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Soft, tall-topped muffins studded with blueberries.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
In a jug mix the milk, oil, egg and vanilla, then pour into the dry mix and stir until just combined.
steps.tip: Lumps are fine. Overmixing makes tough muffins.

steps.text: Fold in the blueberries and divide the batter between the holes.
Bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy cookies with crisp edges and pools of melted chocolate.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and line two trays.
Beat the butter with both sugars until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix the flour, baking soda and salt, and stir into the butter mixture. Fold in the chocolate.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls onto the trays, well apart.
steps.tip: Chilling the dough for 30 minutes makes thicker cookies.

steps.text: Bake until the edges are golden but the centres still look soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownies
recipes.description: Dense, fudgy chocolate brownies with a shiny crust.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20 cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, stir until smooth and let cool slightly.
Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time, and the vanilla. Beat well for a shiny top.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt until just combined, and spread into the tin.
Bake until the top is set and a skewer shows moist crumbs. Cool fully before cutting.
steps.tip: Underbaking by a minute keeps the centre fudgy.

recipes.title: Masala Chai
recipes.description: Strong spiced milk tea with cardamom, ginger and cinnamon.

steps.text: Simmer the water with the cardamom, ginger and cinnamon.
steps.tip: Crush the spices lightly so they release more flavour.

steps.text: Add the tea leaves and the sugar and let it brew.
Pour in the milk and bring to a gentle boil, watching so it does not overflow.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

recipes.title: Strawberry Milkshake
recipes.description: Thick, cold milkshake blended with fresh strawberries and ice cream.

steps.text: Put the strawberries, milk, sugar and ice cream in a blender.
Add the ice cubes for a thicker, colder shake.
Blend until completely smooth and pour into tall glasses.
Top with a strawberry or whipped cream and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Iced Coffee
recipes.description: Sweet, creamy iced coffee made in two minutes.

steps.text: Stir the coffee and sugar into the hot water until dissolved.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in the cold milk, then the coffee syrup.
steps.tip: Pour the coffee slowly over the back of a spoon for a layered look.

steps.text: Stir and drink right away.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: Velvety soup of browned mushrooms, garlic and cream.

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in butter in a wide pot until golden, in two batches if needed.
steps.tip: Do not crowd the pot: they should brown, not steam.

steps.text: Add the onion and garlic and cook until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for a minute, then pour in the stock gradually.
Add the thyme, salt and pepper and simmer. Blend part of the soup for a thicker texture.
Stir in the cream, heat through and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun
recipes.description: Soft milk dumplings fried until golden and soaked in cardamom syrup.

steps.text: Boil the sugar, water and cardamom for a few minutes to a light syrup. Keep it warm.
Mix the milk powder, flour, baking powder and ghee, then add the milk gradually to make a soft dough.
Rest the dough, then roll into smooth, crack-free balls.
steps.tip: Cracks in the balls become cracks in the dumplings.

steps.text: Fry on low heat, turning constantly, until deep golden all over.
steps.tip: Keep the oil only moderately hot so they cook through.

steps.text: Drop the hot dumplings into the warm syrup and soak.
steps.tip: Wait at least 2 hours for the syrup to reach the centre.
